create_fasta_dataset: create a FastaDataset from a FASTA file path to load protein sequences as a PyTorch dataset
build_index_fasta: build an index of byte offsets and sequence lengths for a FASTA file using grep and awk
create_encoded_fasta_dataset: create an EncodedFastaDataset that returns token indices using a dictionary instead of raw sequences
check_fasta_exists: check if a FASTA file exists at the given prefix path using the exists static method
summarize_fasta_dataset_class: summarize the FastaDataset class that provides thread-safe lazy loading of protein sequences from FASTA files
